grade_rationale.text: Karadžić records the vještica as a Serbian belief in his 1818 and 1852 dictionaries, which count as one source.
Afanasyev's Serbian passage on the вѣштица cites Karadžić's Srpski rječnik and quotes its entry, so for Serbs it is not independent of Karadžić.
Afanasyev equates the вѣдьма with the Serbian вѣштица ("душа вѣдьмы (вѣштицы)").
Afanasyev records the вѣдьма for Russians and in the Ukraine and Little Russia from collections other than Karadžić.

Three peoples therefore rest on two independent 19th-century collectors: Karadžić for Serbs, Afanasyev for Russians and Ukrainians; no single people has two independent sources, and the link between them is Afanasyev's equation.
